outer_pool: original 64 TRAIN records only; original32 HOLDOUT excluded from all new fitting and scoring
outer_order: sha256(hepta-nested-outer-v1: + case_id), ranks modulo4; labels never enter ordering
inner_order: sha256(hepta-nested-inner-v1: + case_id), ranks modulo3 within outer48
calibration: original32 CAL records, disjoint8/8/16 slices by original text hash, only after actual checkpoint
optimizer: FP64 full-batch SGD, zero init385x4, lr0.1, nonbias L2=0.001; train-only mean/RMS floor1e-6
prior: three equal-mass curve types, rates=(count+1)/18; 32-to48 sample-size transfer remains unverified
diagnostic: one separate paid full128 target curve per outer fold; never supplied to the controller
forecast_metrics: prior predictive mean, binomial-mixture count log score and central95% model interval; not a coverage guarantee
independence: outer evaluation records are disjoint, fitted folds and shared CAL overlap; four independent task families NOT established
source_status: retrospective nested reanalysis of historically used source records, not genuinely unseen task sources
qualification: record-level exclusion is required, not sufficient for cross-source policy transfer; no automatic promotion
